name: zsnd_sample_set_get_sample_at
description: zSndSampleSet::GetSampleAt returns a sample pointer at index * sizeof(zSndSample), with the original signed upper-bound check and no lower-bound check.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_facs produced symbol ?GetSampleAt@zSndSampleSet@@QAEPAUzSndSample@@H@Z with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x4a0e90 after trimming 11 trailing VC NOP bytes (BN size 37, VC size 48).
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a0e90 validates returning null when this is null or index >= sampleCount, and otherwise returning &samples[index] using sizeof(zSndSample) == 184 with no lower-bound check.
The native smoke verifies valid indices, out-of-range index, and the original negative-index behavior by checking that GetSampleAt(-1) returns the sample immediately before the base pointer.
